name: Giallo
summary: An Italian murder film in saturated colour. A killer in black gloves is seen only as a hand and a blade. The camera moves as the killer sees, and the set glows in red, blue and green gels.

philosophy.core_thesis: Saturated gel light, a killer's-eye camera and a stylised set make the murder a piece of design, so fear comes from the look more than from the plot.
design_principles: Light with coloured gels in red, blue and green, and mix 2 saturated colours in one frame.
Show the killer as a gloved hand, a coat and a blade, and keep the face off screen until the last reel.
Put the camera at the killer's point of view, and move it by 0.3 to 1 m/s through a door or a window.
Shoot each murder as a set piece of 60 to 180 s, with a wide lens of 18mm to 24mm and a slow build.
Use a bold set, with a wallpaper, a statue, a mirror or a painting in the frame.
Hold a close-up of an eye, a key or a glass for 1 to 3 s as a clue.
Dub all sound after the shoot and let the score run loud over the murder.
anti_patterns: A killer shown in the open from the start
A plot that explains all the clues

composition.framing: A wide 2.35:1 or 1.85:1 frame with a saturated wall, a mirror or a painting that sets a second frame; a black glove at the frame edge.
composition.staging_in_depth: 3 planes: a foreground object or a glove, the victim, and a coloured wall or window at the back.
composition.subject_placement: The victim off the centre at 1/3; the killer's hand enters from the frame edge.

principles.rule: Fill the frame with one gel colour and put a second gel colour in the shadow.
principles.value: 2 gel colours, 60% / 30% / 10% with a black accent

principles.rule: Pair a saturated coloured wash with a deep black shadow.
Draw the eye to the weapon or the eye with the one bright spot in the frame.
Put the lens where the killer stands, and keep it at the height of the eye.
principles.value: 1.5 to 1.7 m, 1 point-of-view move per scene

principles.rule: Slow the cut as the killer nears, then cut fast at the blow.
principles.value: 6 to 10 s build, 0.5 to 1 s at the blow

camera_and_movement.movement: A gliding point-of-view dolly or crane through a flat; a fast zoom to the victim's eye; a swirl around a room.
camera_and_movement.support: Dolly, crane and a handheld rig for the point-of-view moves
camera_and_movement.camera_height: 1.5 to 1.7 m for the killer's view; 0.5 to 1.0 m for a victim on the floor

lens_and_format.focal_length: 18mm to 24mm wide; 85mm to 135mm for an eye close-up
lens_and_format.focus: Deep focus in wide shots, a shallow focus on the eye
equipment: coloured gels in red, blue and green

light.quality: Hard coloured light from a gel on a lamp, with a deep black shadow.
light.direction: From a window or a lamp in the set, from the side or below.
light.colour_temperature: Mixed: 3200K tungsten with red, blue or green gels
light.source: Gelled lamps, a neon sign and a lit window

colour_and_grade.treatment: A saturated colour print where red, blue and green wash a whole wall, with black shadow.
grade_recipe: Raise the saturation by 25% to 40% in red, blue and green.
Set the black point at 3% and use a contrast curve of +25%.
Keep the whites tinted by the gel; do not neutralise them.
Do not add a teal and orange split.
colour_and_grade.texture: 35mm grain at 15% to 20%, with a hard gel wash

editing_and_rhythm.average_shot_length: 5 to 9 s (estimate; check Cinemetrics for each title)
editing_and_rhythm.shot_length_range: 0.5 s for a blow to 60 s for a stalk
editing_and_rhythm.cutting_logic: Build a murder in 3 beats: stalk, strike and the clue; cut to the score and end on an eye or a mirror.
editing_and_rhythm.transitions: Hard cut, a snap zoom and a short dissolve for a flashback.

sound.approach: Post-synchronised sound with loud steps, breath and a knife; the dub is in several languages.
sound.dialogue: Short and stiff; clues come in a line or an object.
sound.music: A loud, rhythmic score with a rock band, a choir and a keyboard.
sound.loudness: −23 LUFS integrated, with loud peaks at the murder

titles_and_graphics.treatment: A bold title over a painted or a coloured graphic; a knife or an eye in the card.
titles_and_graphics.type: A bold sans-serif or a script in red and white, 3 to 5 s per card.

shot_primer.opening: Open on a gloved hand and a blade in the first 30 s, with a loud score and no face.

shot_list.shot: Victim lit in a red wash
Mirror and statue in the room

positive: stylised set with a statue and a painting

canonical_works.work: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
The Girl Who Knew Too Much

emotion.target_response: Dread and delight: the viewer feels fear in a beautiful set and cannot look away from the colour.

use_cases: fashion and perfume films with a dark mood
avoid_when: The brief needs a calm, real or clinical look.
The scene needs even light for a product or a demo.

modifiers.how: Drop the gels; shoot in black and white with one hard key and a voice-over.
Replace the gels with signs and street light, and move the story to a modern night city.

sources.title: Mikel J. Koven, La Dolce Morte: Vernacular Cinema and the Italian Giallo Film (Scarecrow Press, 2006)
Troy Howarth, So Deadly, So Perverse: 50 Years of Italian Giallo Films (Midnight Marquee Press, 2015)
